text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The unexpectedly fierce contest at the 
Sprinters Stakes became the talk of the 
town, drawing many people to the 
racecourse today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono herself was so pumped up 
that she even prepared a giant tiered 
bento box!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—That said, having just finished lunch, 
she decided to save the boxed lunch for 
dinner and take on the Mile Championship!
